# Mum's Kitchen

> Authentic Korean & Bangladeshi home-style food in Tranmere, South Australia.

Mum's Kitchen is a restaurant located at 66 Reid Avenue, Tranmere SA 5073, Australia.
Phone: +61 406 878 202

## What We Offer

- Korean fried chicken, bibimbap, rice bowls, soups & stews, noodles, snacks
- Bangladeshi mains, biryani, curry, snacks
- Dine-in, takeaway, and delivery
- Online ordering with card payment via Stripe

## Opening Hours

- Tuesday–Thursday: 5 pm – 10 pm
- Friday–Sunday: 10 am – 3 pm · 5 pm – 10 pm
- Monday: Closed

## Online Ordering

Customers can browse the menu and place orders at mumskitchentranmere.com.au/order
